# Supadata

Supadata is a web and video-to-text API that extracts transcripts from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter) and video files, retrieves social media metadata, and converts web content to markdown for AI training and content analysis.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/supadata/.

## Actions

- **Get YouTube Channel Metadata** (read-only): Fetch metadata of a youtube channel.
- **Get YouTube Channel Videos** (read-only): Retrieve videos from a youtube channel.
- **Get YouTube Playlist** (read-only): Fetch metadata of a youtube playlist.
- **Get YouTube Playlist Videos** (read-only): Fetch videos from a youtube playlist.
- **Get YouTube Video Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve metadata of a youtube video.
- **Search YouTube** (read-only): Search youtube for videos, channels, or playlists.
- **Web Scrape** (read-only): Extract content from a specified website.
- **Website URL Map** (read-only): Retrieve all urls from a specified website.
